blocks.text: Khabonina is revolutionising the cosmetics industry with her innovativenatural and organic approach. Passionate about harnessing nature’s super ingredients, she crafts products that pamper, protect, and empower customers to glow from within.

Through her creative direction and leadership, Khanatural is becoming a go-to name for authentic, effective, and sustainable beauty and wellness experiences that nourish both body and soul. Committed to quality, integrity, and customer well-being, Khabonina is redefining the natural cosmetics industry and inspiring a new generation of conscious beauty enthusiasts.

blocks.text: She’s Khanatural Brand’s Founder, an award winning International Actress and Founder of Khabonina Foundation. See her acting career work on the site link below.  Through the foundation, she works with township schools for social impact.

Discover the empowering legacy of Irish Sea Moss. A resilient superfood that has been a beacon of hope and nourishment for centuries. Our founder, Ms. Khabonina Qubeka, was deeply inspired by the incredible story of Irish Sea Moss, which has its roots in the triumphant spirit of the Irish people.

During the Great Irish Potato Famine (1845-1852), this remarkable seaweed became a lifeline, providing essential nutrients and sustenance to families in need. Its impact was so profound that it has been a cherished part of Irish heritage ever since.
